method: Signature cycles use real combat actors alongside existing mechanisms; Iron Halo replaces its old blade contacts while its cutting rings are active.

evolutions.name: Storm Network
evolutions.desc: Three storm pylons form an electrical triangle, striking its edges and branching lightning into nearby ships.

evolutions.name: Starbreaker
evolutions.desc: A star core cracks at the target, then six explosive fragments strike an expanding ring around it.

evolutions.name: Iron Halo
evolutions.desc: Two counter-rotating steel cutting rings shred close ships and intercept shots at their moving blades.

evolutions.name: Living Plague
evolutions.desc: Three spore reactors spread a creeping toxic network; destroyed ships seed a fourth growth and repair hull.

evolutions.name: Photon Echo
evolutions.desc: Three echo drones form a moving triangular battery and fire staggered piercing volleys.

evolutions.name: Railneedle Storm
evolutions.desc: Six rail emitters sweep a dense piercing needle storm across the firing lane.

evolutions.name: Scatter Sun
evolutions.desc: Four explosive sunlets spiral out, pulsing as they travel and detonating at the edge of their orbit.

evolutions.name: Eventide Discs
evolutions.desc: Three broad crescent discs sweep outward and return through the fleet on curved paths.

evolutions.name: Glacial Bloom
evolutions.desc: A glacial flower opens in eight stages, sending freezing crystalline shock fronts through the fleet.

evolutions.name: Solar Lance
evolutions.desc: An exposed solar reactor fires a sustained broad lance that slowly tracks its target, with repeated burning contact.

evolutions.name: Constellation Salvo
evolutions.desc: A missile carrier launches six curving warheads; each splits once into two homing bomblets.

evolutions.name: Salvage Swarm
evolutions.desc: A carrier deploys seven harvesting drones that fire on nearby ships and sweep XP towards the pilot.

evolutions.name: Aegis Supernova
evolutions.desc: Four shield vanes project an expanding supernova shell, damaging ships and converting intercepted fire into shield.

evolutions.name: Shrapnel Garden
evolutions.desc: A six-mine garden erupts in sequence, sending piercing thorns towards nearby ships.

evolutions.name: Tidal Collapse
evolutions.desc: A vast tidal vortex drags ships into its centre before an expanding collapse shockwave.

evolutions.name: Event Horizon
evolutions.desc: Three orbiting black holes pull separate packs together and collapse into a central void detonation.

evolutions.name: Thunderhook
evolutions.desc: Four thunderhooks cage the target, drag nearby ships into its edges and branch electric strikes.

evolutions.name: Solar Slipstream
evolutions.desc: Twin solar engines lay a braided burning wake behind the ship; using its ability adds crosswise fire trails.

evolutions.name: Prismatic Array
evolutions.desc: Three orbiting satellites form a prism reactor and refract their beams through a shared target.

evolutions.name: Junkstar Barrage
evolutions.desc: An armoured scrap star bursts into nine jagged fragments that ricochet inside a widening flight box.

evolutions.name: Storm Bastions
evolutions.desc: Three fortified bastions lock down a triangular area, branching lightning and intercepting fire along their links.

evolutions.name: Razor Squadron
evolutions.desc: A V formation of three heavy saw fighters dives through the pack and wheels back across the pilot.

evolutions.name: Meteor Battery
evolutions.desc: An orbital battery walks five staggered meteor impacts across the fleet, each with a visible landing mark.

evolutions.name: Grey Tide
evolutions.desc: Nine nanite drones advance as a wave, infecting ships along their path and repairing hull on a shared capped pulse.

evolutions.name: Rift Torpedoes
evolutions.desc: Three rift mouths open around the target and fire phase torpedoes inward from different directions.

evolutions.name: Resonance Engine
evolutions.desc: A resonance turbine releases three expanding pressure walls; each wall damages once and drives ordinary ships outward.

evolutions.name: Parallax Lance
evolutions.desc: Three separated rail accelerators converge on a distant target, carving piercing lanes through the whole pack.

evolutions.name: Supernova Flak
evolutions.desc: A stellar shell detonates at the target and hurls ten heavy fragments outward, each with a final burst.

evolutions.name: Lunar Reapers
evolutions.desc: Three oversized lunar reapers circle the target in a shrinking eclipse, then scythe back towards the pilot.

evolutions.name: Fusion Grid
evolutions.desc: Four pylons unfold into a diamond fusion fortress with crossed plasma links that repeatedly burn passing ships.

evolutions.name: Sanguine Circuit
evolutions.desc: A blood reactor connects four ships into a drain circuit, returning capped repair pulses to the pilot.

evolutions.name: Absolute Zero
evolutions.desc: A containment core cracks open into six frozen blast zones that interrupt ordinary ships and slow bosses.

evolutions.name: Titan Drive
evolutions.desc: A massive siege prow projects three advancing pressure wedges along the pilot’s heading, battering ships aside.

evolutions.name: Helios Wings
evolutions.desc: Four articulated solar wings sweep rotating beam spokes around the pilot, with gaps between the hot lanes.

evolutions.name: Black Bloom
evolutions.desc: Three singularity buds blossom in succession, drawing ships inward before each releases a second void pulse.

evolutions.name: Event Lock
evolutions.desc: A six-node containment cage rotates around a time-lock core, slowing ships and intercepting a limited number of hostile shots.

evolutions.name: Tempest Cathedral
evolutions.desc: Five spires rise around a storm core and discharge a staggered lightning circuit across the trapped fleet.

evolutions.name: Harmonic Horizon
evolutions.desc: Three displaced resonance gates emit overlapping travelling pressure walls, each with its own expanding front.

evolutions.name: Gemini Battery
evolutions.desc: Two heavy satellite batteries alternate four crossing beam lanes through the pilot’s firing field.

evolutions.name: Core Breacher
evolutions.desc: Industrial jaws clamp a marked hull while two diamond drills converge; the final impact bursts into nearby ships.

evolutions.name: Citadel Orbit
evolutions.desc: Four heavy sentries form a moving orbital fortress, fire outward and intercept shots at their shields.

evolutions.name: Nebula Reservoir
evolutions.desc: Three plasma reservoirs flow together around the target, growing into one pulsing nebula before dispersing.

evolutions.name: Reactor Pinball
evolutions.desc: Five reflector nodes contain a ricocheting reactor star; each wall impact emits a damaging pulse.

evolutions.name: Orbital Reaping
evolutions.desc: Three gigantic harvesting crescents spiral outward and sweep back across their original firing lanes.

evolutions.name: Polar Cascade
evolutions.desc: Four polar emitters project an ion cross which rotates between its repeated piercing discharges.

evolutions.name: Soul Reactor
evolutions.desc: An exposed soul reactor releases coronal pulses and sends three repair motes around its burning shell.

evolutions.name: Crimson Gyre
evolutions.desc: Three long plasma arms rotate into a crimson vortex, dragging nearby ships across the moving hot strands.

evolutions.name: Binary Supercluster
evolutions.desc: Six linked drones form a miniature constellation and cascade three alternating bombardment zones around the pilot.
